The coach reads the curve, compares the photos over time, and writes the diet and the program. Calories and macros come from a food database, never an estimate. No AI decides anything here, the coach does. Body photos are kept in private storage with short lived signed links, hosted in the EU. Free for your first 2 clients.

posts.name: promptring
posts.tagline: that little tring 🔔 the moment your terminal agent is done
posts.description: promptring (prompt·tring) fires real desktop notification banners when your GitHub Copilot CLI agent finishes a task, needs your input, or hits a blocker. Native banners on the latest macOS Copilot CLI — powered by Claude — plus Windows, Linux and WSL, with python3 as the only dependency, from any terminal (Terminal.app, iTerm2, VS Code). Built by Pratyansh Agrawal.

posts.name: Premium Bonds Results
posts.tagline: Visualise your Premium Bond Results stats and get alerts
posts.description: Privacy-first Premium Bonds results, stats and insights. See your personal stats, high value wins a day early and the global stats for all premium bonds. The database contains over 600 million wins and is updated every month. Sign up to email win alerts sent when the results are released, days before the official emails are sent.

posts.name: Snapr
posts.tagline: Capture thoughts, find them instantly
posts.description: AI-powered productivity for working professionals. Voice-to-structured notes, smart bookmarking, and file organization in one place. Stop switching between apps, save everything, find anything, instantly.

posts.name: Listove AI
posts.tagline: Turn 1 product into 11 optimized marketplace listings in 10s
posts.description: Selling across multiple marketplaces means rewriting the exact same listing 11 times to fit character limits, character constraints, and platform-specific tones. Listove AI automates this entire reseller headache. Enter your product details once, select your target platforms (Amazon, eBay, Etsy, Vinted, Wallapop, Depop, etc.), and generate 11 optimized, SEO-ready listings in 10 seconds. Supports 6 languages, tailored character rules, and zero raw markdown issues.

posts.name: Shiritai — Furigana Reader for Japanese
posts.tagline: Turn any webpage into a Japanese reading lesson
posts.description: Shiritai is a Chrome extension that turns any web page into a Japanese reading lesson. Toggle furigana on and readings appear above every kanji—on X, Threads, blogs, news, anywhere. The reading engine runs locally, so it's fast and private. Select any text → Explain for a study card: translation, grammar, vocab, kanji, JLPT level, and the casual nuance dictionaries miss. Built for N5–N2 learners reading real Japanese. A companion web app explains any pasted text the same way.

posts.name: Vidaya
posts.tagline: Healthspan score from your wearables, labs, and DNA.
posts.description: Vidaya turns your wearable data, labs, and habits into a real Healthspan score and a personalized longevity plan. Built by founders tired of dashboards that show numbers but never tell you what to actually do next.

posts.name: Crevio AI
posts.tagline: Create consistent AI characters for every ad campaign.
posts.description: Crevio AI helps brands create premium ad creatives, edit product images, and build consistent AI brand characters. Generate multiple variations from a single prompt or photo, keep the same face across every campaign, and scale fashion, skincare, jewelry, fitness, and ecommerce ads faster. 50 free credits on signup.

posts.name: RoundZero
posts.tagline: AI interviews that replace first-round screening.
posts.description: Stop relying on resumes alone. RoundZero runs adaptive AI interviews with qualified applicants and generates evidence-backed reports, helping hiring teams identify the strongest candidates before spending time on live interviews.

posts.name: Hammer
posts.tagline: A simple tool for building stories and worlds they live in.
posts.description: A free, open source story editor for novelists. Scenes you can reorder, an encyclopedia that shows you which scenes your characters are in, a timeline, notes, and stats to help you reach your writing goals. All as plain text files on your own device. Send scenes to your editor for revisions, or share your story with beta readers. Works fully offline on every device you own: Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS. Use a sync server to keep your work up to date across all devices.

posts.name: Leaping AI
posts.tagline: AI agents that call and text in multi-day campaigns
posts.description: We allow companies that operate in the physical world (home remodeling, roofing, trades) to automate inbound and outbound calling & texting and run multi-threaded campaigns spanning several weeks. Our AI agents can hold 100+ parallel conversations, speak in multiple languages and integrate into any CRM. We help put appointment scheduling, customer service & confirmation calls on autopilot and eliminate missed calls, slow speed to lead and insufficient lead follow ups for our customers.

posts.name: EasyDex
posts.tagline: Update your address once, not 20 times
posts.description: EasyDex is a contact-sharing platform that keeps everyone's details current. Change your address, phone, or email once and the update flows to every person — and every business — connected to you. No more calling your bank, insurer, and utilities after a move.

posts.name: JS Quest
posts.tagline: Learn JavaScript by playing Games
posts.description: JS Quest: a free, login-free adventure that teaches you ALL of JavaScript — from your first variable to the event loop's deepest secrets. 16 realms, 239 levels, 16 boss battles, XP, streaks and real in-browser coding.

posts.name: Host Better
posts.tagline: Launch your website in minutes, not hours.
posts.description: Host Better makes launching a website simple. Upload your website, connect a custom domain, enable free SSL, and go live in minutes. Built for small businesses, freelancers, startups, and anyone who wants reliable hosting without the technical complexity. Fast performance, secure infrastructure, and affordable plans starting at just ₹179/month.

posts.name: NetPulse
posts.tagline: A local Mac network monitor that lives in your menu bar
posts.description: NetPulse is a native Mac utility for seeing how busy your connection is, which app is using it, and whether your VPN is active. It shows live speeds in the menu bar or a floating panel, HTTPS response time, request failure rate and latency stability across three targets—not ICMP packet loss—exit/local/real public IP, and per-app traffic. Daily, weekly and monthly totals stay on the Mac. No account, ads, analytics or subscription. $1.99 once on the Mac App Store.

posts.name: FutureRoast
posts.tagline: Predict your future through the lens of AI
posts.description: Get roasted byFutureRoast is a playful AI web app that “roasts” your future self based on your photo. Upload a selfie and get a humorous, personalized glimpse of what your future might look like — from career vibes to cosmic chaos. Built for fun, fast loading, and instant laughs. the future. Upload a selfie and discover your destiny.

posts.name: MacSonik Outlook PST Converter Tool
posts.tagline: Convert & Manage PST Files on Mac, Win & Linux
posts.description: MacSonik Outlook PST Converter is an enterprise-ready tool to convert, migrate, and manage Outlook PST files across macOS, Windows, and Linux—without Outlook. Export PST to 20+ formats, migrate directly to Microsoft 365, Gmail, IMAP, and more, or process unlimited PST files in bulk. With advanced filters, duplicate removal, smart preview, modern OAuth authentication, and zero data loss, it’s built for IT teams, MSPs, and professionals handling secure, large-scale email migrations.

posts.name: KidsMask
posts.tagline: Keep your child visible. Mosaic the rest.
posts.description: Sharing videos of your child's birthday, sports game, or school event? Other kids appear in the frame. KidsMask solves this in one tap. Auto-detects faces, keeps YOUR child visible, mosaics the rest. Manual editing catches auto misses. 100% on-device — no cloud, no data collection. One-time $4.99 for Pro.

posts.name: Image Tool
posts.tagline: Convert & resize whole folders of images in one command
posts.description: Bulk image converter & resizer — convert and resize entire folders of images in one command. - Pexi-Studio-Dev/image-tool

posts.name: Stashr
posts.tagline: Save the whole post. Find it with AI.
posts.description: You bookmark all over the internet: X, Reddit, TikTok, Instagram, and beyond, and it vanishes into separate apps, where half is deleted when you look again. Stashr captures every save automatically and keeps the whole post: text, images, and metadata, not just a link that can rot. AI tags each one, and search understands meaning, so "that pasta video" turns up even when the caption never says pasta. Your AI tools connect through MCP, CLI, and API. More platforms ship regularly. Free trial.

posts.name: AI in a Day
posts.tagline: The non-technical playbook to automate your work with AI.
posts.description: Stop feeling overwhelmed by AI. "AI in a Day" is a highly actionable PDF guide built for non-technical professionals. Learn how to automate daily tasks, look smarter in meetings, and build a modern workflow—no coding required.

posts.name: Vitae
posts.tagline: Binaural beats & Pomodoro to help you actually focus
posts.description: Vitae uses scientifically-backed binaural beats to enhance focus and concentration. Includes Pomodoro timer, ambient sounds, and offline functionality.

posts.name: LLM SEO
posts.tagline: The Google Search Console for AI search engines.
posts.description: Traditional SEO tools tell you how you rank on Google. LLMSEO tells you how you rank on AI. As ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Gemini replace standard search, being cited in AI answers is the next distribution frontier.

posts.name: Unstuck
posts.tagline: Stop losing hours to ADHD waiting mode
posts.description: Waiting mode is the ADHD freeze where one 2pm meeting makes the whole morning unusable, your brain guards the clock instead of starting anything. Unstuck reads your Google Calendar (read-only), finds the gap before your next commitment, scores which task is safe to start, and fires hard-stop alerts at T-15 and T-5 so starting doesn't risk being late. Free tier available.
